frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/components/ConnectionStatus.tsx:104-113 — the root element is a <div> that, when disconnected, is made fully interactive: onClick (line 109) and onKeyDown handling Enter/Space (lines 86-96) both call reconnect(), and tabIndex flips to 0 (line 113). But its role is hardcoded role="status" (line 111), a live region, not role="button".

Assistive-tech users reach a focusable element announced as a status/live region rather than an actionable control, so the click-to-reconnect affordance (surfaced visually in the tooltip, lines 126-130) is not conveyed semantically; this is also the classic non-interactive-element-with-handlers a11y smell Biome's a11y rules target. Recommend rendering a real <button> (or role="button") for the reconnect affordance while keeping a separate aria-live region for the status text.

Confidence medium: static-only review; the visual/mouse path works and keyboard activation is wired, so impact is a11y-semantics degradation on the WebSocket status widget rather than a functional break.
